job.job_description:
We are looking for a highly skilled GenAI Engineer to join our team at Sigmasoft Infotech Private Limited. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in artificial intelligence and machine learning, with the ability to develop and implement AI solutions.



Roles and Responsibility




Design and develop AI models and algorithms to solve complex problems.


Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI into existing systems.


Develop and maintain large-scale data pipelines and architectures.


Conduct research and stay updated on the latest AI trends and technologies.


Work closely with stakeholders to understand business needs and develop AI solutions.


Deploy and monitor AI models in production environments.




Job Requirements




Strong understanding of machine learning fundamentals and deep learning techniques.


Experience with programming languages such as Python, Java, or C++.


Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.


Familiarity with containerization using Docker and Kubernetes.


Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.


Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
